injuries.description: soft tissue injury of the lower back
source: Dr Chiang concluded that the plaintiff had suffered either a soft tissue injury of the lower back or prolapse of a lower lumbar disc with the latter being the “more likely” and that “a L5/S1 disc proplase was quite likely to have sustained from the injury”. He opined that it would have a good chance of improving with conservative treatment.
